column1: # npm-pre-scan evaluation corpus — LEGITIMATE "PARENT" PACKAGES (benign controls)
# Purpose : the real, legitimate packages that the malicious names in
#           eval/corpus/real_malicious_holders.tsv imitate, plus a few popular
#           controls. Every flag raised here is a FALSE POSITIVE. This is the
#           only arm that can produce an FPR, and the dynamic subset produces
#           the project's first-ever measured Layer 2/3 false-positive rate.
# Source  : parents of the 2017 typosquat campaign + high-download packages from
#           data/top_packages.txt. Dependency counts and install hooks verified
# ================= WHY ONLY SOME ENTRIES CARRY layers=2,3 ====================
# The Layer 2/3 sandbox runs `npm install --offline` under `--network=none`, so
# dependencies CANNOT be fetched. A package with dependencies fails its install
# by the try/catch) — producing an EMPTY behaviour profile that reads as a clean
# PASS. That is a vacuous result, not evidence of precision.
# So `layers` here is set to 2,3 ONLY for packages verified to declare ZERO
# dependencies. Dependency-bearing packages are capped at layers=0,1 and their
# declared_deps is recorded, keeping them out of the dynamic denominators
# instead of silently inflating the true-negative count.
# --- dependency-free: full dynamic analysis is meaningful (the FPR arm) ------
